messages.risk.each_pregnancy_independent: Each pregnancy is an independent chance. Previous results do not change the next chance.
messages.risk.unsupported: This input is outside the supported teaching model. No estimate is given.
messages.risk.educational_only: This gene is outside the calculation model. No numerical estimate is given.
messages.risk.review_required: The input needs review. Uncertain or incomplete information is not treated as an absent finding.
messages.risk.unknown: The information is unknown. No number is given.
messages.risk.neither_carrier: Neither parent has a changed copy in this idealized model. This is not a statement about real test certainty.
messages.risk.single_carrier: One parent has a changed copy in this model. Read the conditional model numbers with the test-limit notes.
messages.risk.shared_gene_conditional: The chance shown applies if both carry disease-causing changes in this gene. Gene-level information alone cannot confirm the combination.
messages.risk.counsellor_context: No number is given when the relationship is uncertain. A genetic counsellor can help discuss the context.
messages.risk.reference_unavailable: An appropriate numerical reference is unavailable. Missing numbers have not been replaced with an assumption.
messages.risk.population_model: These are population-model estimates for the selected teaching assumptions, not a personal prediction.
messages.risk.related_residual_not_modelled: This is an individual carrier estimate. A related couple’s residual chance is not computed here.
messages.risk.individual_residual_only: This is an individual carrier estimate after a hypothetical negative result, not a couple-level estimate.
messages.risk.covered_model: The calculation describes only the supported genes and inputs in this teaching model.
messages.risk.own_carrier: Your fictional report records carrier status for this gene. This is not a diagnosis.
messages.risk.own_no_finding: Your fictional report records no finding in the tested scope. This does not settle all remaining uncertainty.
messages.risk.own_status_summary: This is your own fictional report summary. It is not an estimate for a future child.
messages.risk.no_shared_finding: No shared carrier finding is released in this view. Partner-only findings are not shown.
messages.risk.stale_binding: This view is stale. Clear it and request a new calculation explicitly after checking current permissions.
messages.risk.assessment_required: Current processing and the separate assessment permission are required before this own summary can be shown.
messages.risk.input_rejected: The teaching input was not accepted. No estimate was generated.

caveats.GENE_LEVEL_ONLY: A shared gene does not confirm the relevant disease-causing changes. Laboratory and counsellor context is still needed.
caveats.IDEALIZED_STATUS_MODEL: These outcomes assume the stated copy statuses in a simple recessive model.
caveats.NEGATIVE_NOT_ZERO_RESIDUAL_UNKNOWN: A negative field is not proof of no remaining chance. Test scope and detection information matter.
caveats.SINGLE_ALLELE_POPULATION_MODEL: This is a simplified population model for one allele-frequency assumption. It does not cover every genetic mechanism.
caveats.USER_SCENARIO_ONLY: The numerical input is a teaching assumption, not an observed condition frequency.
caveats.SAME_SCENARIO_POPULATION: Both inputs describe the same hypothetical population. They are not a mix of unrelated reference groups.
caveats.IDEALIZED_DETECTION_MODEL: Detection is an input assumption. A complete-detection setting is not a claim about any real laboratory.

states.OWN_CARRIER: Carrier recorded in your fictional report
states.OWN_NO_FINDING: No finding recorded in your fictional tested scope
states.SHARED_CARRIER: Shared carrier finding in the fictional model
states.SINGLE_CARRIER: One carrier in the teaching model
states.NEITHER_CARRIER: Neither carrier in the teaching model
